page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, left column then right column. Column heads "ת כ" at the top of each column (running head). Page number 436 at top left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָשַׁר[?]
וַתִּיּשַׁר[?] & rectum visum es, vel fuit, fut. Kal, תִּיָּשַׁר[?] diriges, vel get, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָשַׁר.
main_text.head: ת כ
main_text.p: וַתַּכְתָּ[?] & percussisti, vel sit, (apoc. pro תַּכָּה,) תַּכֶּנּוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נָכָה.
תַךְ dolus, fraus, No. f. m. à Rad. inusit. תָּכַךְ.
וַתַּכָּה & caligavit, Job. 17.7. (pro תַּכְהָה,) וַתַּכְהֵין & caligarunt, (pro [illegible, ~3 letters]) fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. f. Rad. כָּהָה.
תֻּכּוּ percutiemini, fut. Hoph, 2. pl. m. R. נָכָה.
תֻּכּוּ medientur, Deut. 33. 3. præt. Pual, 3. pl. Rad. תָּכָה; vel, ut quidam deducunt, potest esse à Rad. תָּוָךְ, vel תָּכַךְ.
תִּכָּוֶינָה[?] uremini, vel urentur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. כָּוָה.
תִּכּוֹן stabilieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כּוֹן.
תְּכוּנָתוֹ לַ־תְּכוּנָה apparatui, dispositio ejus, No. f. f. præf. & aff. Rad. כּוֹן aptavit.
תְּכוּנִין aptabis, vel bit, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כּוּן.
תִּכּוֹנִין firmeris, vel tur, Num.21.27. תִּכּוֹנָנִי stabilieris, (pro תִּתְכּוֹנִין, תִּתְכּוֹנָנִי,) fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. & 2. sing. fæm. Rad. כּוֹן.
תִּכָּחֵד exscinderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּחַד.
תָּכִּים, vel תּוּכִּיִּים pavones, psittaci. No. pl. m. Rad. תָּכַךְ.
תָּכִין parabis, vel bit, תָּכִיךְ te, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel

page.notes: Hebrew forms marked [?] are uncertain at this scan resolution, notably the vowel points and the root words after "Rad.". The parenthetical "(pro ...)" after "caligarunt" is illegible. The last line continues on the next page. Long s in "exscinderis" printed as "exfcinderis" was read as sc (s). Running head is the Hebrew letters ת כ on both columns.
